FB-E01.statement: SetTeamFormation T22635 declares Team, FormationTarget, FormationType, ServantState, FormationConfigName, RemoveDying, CustomFormationName, UseLevelAreaRoot, CustomCenterTargetType, CustomFormationIgnoreDying, ImmediatelyStopHeadLookAt, RefreshFormationCenter and TeamMemberCountingOption. No explicit entity creation specification, member array, slot/index, append/remove/swap opcode is declared here.

FB-E02.statement: Saved bridge identifies executor AMJKHOCLEGG T56558. OnTaskBegin M517681 has a 112-byte call summary with M517683 at 0x15321A50 and M517682 at 0x15321B20, plus GetPatch M732322. Helper M517686 at 0x15321E70 is declared separately. No helper body/dataflow is available in inspected saved artifacts; callee-list order is not executed order. Absence of direct EvaluateTarget in the wrapper is not absence of target evaluation in helpers.

FB-E03.statement: TeamFormationComponent has separate _Team, _AllTeammate, _TeamFormationDatas, _FormationDatasNormal, _CustomUpdateFormationDatas, _UseCustomFormationMembers and _FormationInCameraSpace; world centers, width, rotation, row filters and wave runtime ID are separate fields. This establishes distinct declared representations, not their exact element types or aliasing.

FB-E04.statement: Formation membership/index/geometry APIs are distinct: AddTeammateEntity, RemoveTeammateEntity, SetEntityFormationIndex, GetEntityByFormationIndex, GetTeamAdjoinEntity, SortEntityByFormationIndexIncludeRemoved, InverseFormationEntityList, UseCustomFormation, MarkMemberUseCustomPostion and RefreshLocationList. EntityFormationSortData stores Entity, Active, FormationIndex and RemoveVersion separately; this is not proof that SetTeamFormation calls every API.

FB-E05.statement: FormationData has Name, LocationList, RootOffset, ServantMode and IsIncludeTempLeave. TeamFormationType declares normal/select-target/custom modes. NormalTeamFormationServantState declares Default/DefaultFollow/UniformFollow. Field declarations do not recover serialized omission defaults or numeric enum values.

FB-E06.statement: RemoveEntityFromTeamFormation has TargetType and RemainInTeam; AddEntityToTeamFormation is a separate task. DawnsEye explicitly uses RemainInTeam=true. Therefore membership removal and team retention must be expressible independently; exact implementation/default remain unproved.

FB-E07.statement: Feixiao source declares an OnCreate RemoveEntityFromTeamFormation and OnDestroy AddEntityToTeamFormation for the same ModifierOwnerEntity, plus a later phase callback removing that declaration. This is a source-level remove/rejoin lifecycle, not evidence for entity destruction. No Modifier lifecycle semantics are reconstructed in this pass.

FB-E08.statement: FeixiaoPart Self resolves from AllUnselectable with a marker filter; Head/Limb/Tail separately apply TargetMapPartEntity with PartID 1/2/3. That unselectable Self is explicitly used as CustomCenterTargetType. A spatial center/alias reference need not be a selectable combat target.

FB-E09.statement: Feixiao separately declares SummonMonster and DefineHPSharedGroup(MainTarget=Caster, SubTargets=ParamEntityList). The enclosing source selector requests AllUnselectableWithAllTeammate filtered to TeamDark. This records a shared-state relation distinct from formation or part mapping; exact HP behavior is out of scope.

FB-E10.statement: Sunday separately declares HP sharing from ModifierOwnerEntity to CasterSummonedMinions with ResolveShield=true. Summoned membership and shared-state membership may overlap explicitly; they must not be collapsed into one relation.

FB-E11.statement: CharacterDataComponent declares Summoner, Creator, SummonAbilityInst, IsBodyPart and LineupIndex independently. CreateBodyPart M530476 and IsPartEntity M530653 are separate native declarations. TeamDataComponent has an HpSharedModule field. None proves that every boss root has an extra invisible controller entity.

FB-E12.statement: IronTomb source resolves core from BattleAllEntity by unique ID 403501; two part-named entities from AllDarkTeam by unique IDs 403206/403207; phantom from AllUnselectable by unique ID 403502. It does not use TargetMapPartEntity for those two part-named aliases. A body-part-looking name does not establish native parent/PartID membership.

FB-E13.statement: Cocolia Boss_Cocolia_P2_insertAbility orders RemoveEntityFromTeamFormation(Caster), SetEntityVisible(Caster), SummonMonster, then another SetEntityVisible(Caster). The old caster remains referenced after removal and after a separate summon task; removal cannot safely be lowered as destruction.

FB-E14.statement: AML Skill01_Phase01 declares CharacterChangePhase(Caster,Phase2) without local SetTeamFormation; Skill07_Phase01 declares SetTeamFormation(TeamLight,LightTeamNormal) before animation without local CharacterChangePhase. SkillXX_PhaseYY suffix denotes ability segmentation and is not evidence of a boss health phase transition.

FB-E15.statement: Feixiao Skill05_Target is AllLightTeam -> marker filter -> TargetSortByFormation(HighestFirst=true), and FeixiaoPart supplies it as FormationTarget. Native bridge identifies sorter Transform M537942. Formation-relative target ordering is therefore a real dependency, but which normal/custom collection it reads, and whether a particular SetTeamFormation updates that collection, remain unresolved.

FB-E16.statement: TeamFormationComponent declares handlers for battle active-entity, turn-state, camera and skill changes. This supplies candidate incoming dependencies. No inspected saved call path proves a SetTeamFormation write to AV queues, action candidates, inserted owner, or AI actor eligibility.

FB-E17.statement: IronTombCore Skill02_Phase01 applies two named custom layouts to Caster and AllLightTeam before the animation. Its separate SummonMonster request uses RefreshTeamLocation=false. Formation can address selected existing entities on different sides, and spawning and spatial refresh have separate source controls.

FB-E18.statement: EntityManager has _AllEntityDictionary, while unselectable bookkeeping is separately declared on TurnBasedGameMode. TeamData and TeamFormation are distinct native components. Do not make formation the sole registry or substitute its list for all query domains.
